data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? I propose 19 tons each this month: we each earn $19,000 and leave 5 tons, avoiding collapse. That gives us a 75% chance of starting next month at 100 tons and a 25% chance of starting at 10—not a guaranteed refill. We should agree now that if replenishment fails, we reduce our catches to keep at least 5 tons in the lake, rather than repeat the 19-ton limit. We can review everyone’s revealed catches each month and adjust quotas to the actual stock. John, would you support that?
